novelty.evidence: Active pulses, speed-free localisation and acoustic district heating monitoring are each known, but I found no source combining autonomous per-section speed and damping learning with permanent clamp-on sensors; only snippets of most patents were read.

freedom_to_operate.evidence: No patent found that clearly blocks the concept, but active Itron (US11788919, to about 2041) and Kamstrup families partly overlap and no professional FTO search or country-level status check has been done.

technical_maturity.evidence: Lab rig and a 4-month field trial on 2.3 km with 6 sensors show a working prototype (about TRL 5 by my estimate), but with only 3 known leaks and estimated battery life and cost.
